title: ever LILAS|Elegant A-line Waist Applique Ruffled Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant mother of the bride dress features a flattering A-line silhouette, designed to enhance your natural shape. The waist applique adds a touch of delicate detail, while the ruffled accents bring a soft, romantic flair. Perfect for making a graceful statement at any formal occasion, this dress ensures both comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
